subject.title: feat(ui): create catalog sessions from the sidebar

question: Should session catalogs permanently advertise creation as `createSession: { model }`, with core gating it against the default agent's required runtime and the UI locking catalog drafts to that validated agent?
rationale: The implementation is technically coherent and well tested, but it defines a new protocol/provider contract plus an intentional agent-selection policy; tests cannot determine whether that is the long-term product API maintainers want.

options.title: Approve the additive contract
options.body: Accept the current opaque-catalog, gateway-resolved model contract and default-agent lock as the supported permanent behavior.

options.title: Generalize before merge
options.body: Replace the model-only descriptor with a broader creation-target contract that explicitly represents eligible agents or runtime policy before clients adopt this shape.

options.title: Defer catalog creation
options.body: Keep catalog browsing and continuation only, and postpone sidebar creation until the permanent multi-agent contract is decided.

recommendation.title: Approve the additive contract
recommendation.body: Accept the current opaque-catalog, gateway-resolved model contract and default-agent lock as the supported permanent behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: The best available history signal connects this person to the Gateway-backed session and agent routing contracts that this feature extends.
